en_how: Two columns of faux textura are built from minim strokes with lozenge heads and feet on a parchment texture, with red rubrics, a huge initial on tooled gold and an ultramarine-and-vermilion figure in a pointed arch; gold areas are kept as a mask so a diagonal glint sweeps only across them and flashes four-pointed stars, marginal vines grow along a path with a snail and bird creeping on them, and the page turns over at the spine to reveal the next.
